# P2P Networking & Robustness Checklist: Go P2P Sidecar

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and coverage of P2P networking, NAT traversal, and file transfer protocol requirements.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are timeout requirements and retry intervals explicitly defined for Circuit Relay v2 reservations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is the phrase "bounded chunks" explicitly quantified with specific size limits (e.g., 256KB)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are the exact conditions that trigger a `HOLE_PUNCH_FAILED` event clearly defined? [Completeness, Data Model]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec explicitly quantify the "implementation-defined grace period" for closing the relay connection after a successful direct upgrade? [Clarity, Gap]

## Protocol Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Do the transfer status states (`START`, `ACCEPT`, `DATA`, etc.) map consistently to the expected gRPC API events? [Consistency, Data Model]
- [x] CHK006 Are the error codes or messages for file rejections (e.g., `overwrite=false`) consistently documented across the protocol and gRPC boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for how the sidecar should behave if the local disk runs out of space during a transfer? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK008 Are concurrent file transfer limits (e.g., max parallel streams) specified to enforce the 100MB memory ceiling? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for partial transfer resumption if a direct connection drops midway? [Exception Flow, Gap]
- [x] CHK010 Are fallback requirements fully defined for NAT types that completely block hole punching (symmetric NATs)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Does the spec define what happens if the sender disconnects immediately after sending the transfer metadata but before sending chunks? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
